scope: Only the listed properties of the parsed ST transition model. Not all natural-language requirements or hardware correctness.

semantics.state: FB outputs and VAR persist between scans; declared initial values
semantics.arithmetic: same-type assignment additions/subtractions modulo declared width; arithmetic in comparisons refused
semantics.excluded: REAL/LREAL, TIME/LTIME, timers, other FB/function calls, arrays, references, loops, I/O and interrupts

assumptions: Single sequential FB invocation per scan; all inputs assigned before invocation.
No concurrent writes, retained warm-start state, physical I/O or hardware faults modeled.
